inputs.label: Prompt
inputs.description: The instruction describing the image to generate. Boogu-Image is bilingual — English and Chinese instructions are both supported. Detailed, descriptive prompts produce the best results.

inputs.label: Negative Prompt
inputs.description: Describes what should NOT appear in the image. Used for classifier-free guidance; leave empty to disable text negative guidance.

inputs.label: Image Size
inputs.description: The size of the generated image. The model's maximum native resolution is 2K; larger requests are clamped. Dimensions are aligned to multiples of 16.

inputs.label: Num Inference Steps
inputs.description: The number of denoising steps to perform.

inputs.label: Guidance Scale
inputs.description: Controls how closely generation follows the text instruction. Higher values stick more closely to the prompt. A value of 1.0 disables text classifier-free guidance.

inputs.label: Cfg Range Start
inputs.description: Start of the timestep fraction over which CFG is applied.

inputs.label: Cfg Range End
inputs.description: End of the timestep fraction over which CFG is applied.

inputs.label: Num Images
inputs.description: The number of images to generate.

inputs.label: Seed
inputs.description: The same seed and the same prompt given to the same version of the model will output the same image every time.

inputs.label: Enable Safety Checker
inputs.description: If true, the safety checker is run on the generated images. Disabling it requires account authorization; unauthorized requests are always checked, and images flagged as unsafe are returned as black images.

inputs.label: Output Format
inputs.description: The format of the generated image.

inputs.label: Sync Mode
inputs.description: If true, the media is returned as a data URI and the output is not available in the request history.
